scope: Restore the persisted and client-shared Publish 14 faction rank, promotion reserve, purchase transaction, and join/resign reset semantics instead of deriving faction rank from the NGE weekly GCW rating; close the complete Java OnPvpFactionChanged and OnPvpTypeChanged inventories so alternate state listeners cannot introduce later player progression or reward authority.

findings: Publish 14 faction rank is an independently persisted creature value; it is not calculated from NGE weekly GCW rating, lifetime points, PvP kills, profession, or player combat level.
Promotion advances one rank only after the player can pay that rank's authored faction-point cost while retaining the 200-point membership minimum.
Joining and fully resigning reset faction rank to recruit rank zero. A failed rank write must not consume faction standing.

The complete Java source tree contains exactly four PvP state callbacks: three player handlers preserve declaration and covert/overt compatibility without progression or reward mutations, while one non-player turret handler reapplies authored turret faction attributes.
